meals.title: Braai Boerewors with Pap and Tomato Smoor
meals.why: Traditional boerewors is R89.99/kg with a Checkers Xtra Savings card, and a 10kg bag of maize meal at R84.99 makes pap for many dinners.
method: Light the fire and braai the wors over medium coals for 15-20 minutes, turning occasionally.
Fry sliced onion and garlic in oil until soft, then add the chopped tomatoes, salt and a pinch of sugar.
Simmer the tomato smoor for 10-15 minutes until thick and glossy.
Boil 3 cups of water with salt, stir in about 1.5 cups of maize meal, cover and steam on low for 20 minutes to make crumbly pap.
Serve the wors on the pap with the smoor spooned over.

meals.title: Butternut and Cheddar Frittata with Cucumber-Yoghurt Salad
meals.why: Butternut is only R14.99/kg, and eggs (R59.99 for 18 with Xtra Savings) and a cheese block turn it into a filling vegetarian dinner.
method: Dice about 500g butternut and pan-fry with sliced onion in an ovenproof pan for 10-12 minutes until tender.
Beat 6 eggs with salt, pepper, herbs and most of the grated cheddar.
Pour the eggs over the butternut, top with the remaining cheese and cook on low for 4 minutes.
Finish under a hot grill or in a 200°C oven for 8-10 minutes until set and golden.
Mix diced cucumber with yoghurt, a little garlic and lemon juice, and serve alongside.

meals.title: Beef Kofta Paninis with Cucumber Yoghurt
meals.why: Lean beef mince is R99.99/kg with an Xtra Savings card, and the paninis are R15 for four, so dinner for a family is quick and cheap.
method: Mix 500g mince with grated onion, garlic, paprika, cumin, salt and pepper.
Shape into small oval patties or sausage shapes.
Pan-fry in a little oil for 8-10 minutes, turning until browned and cooked through.
Stir grated or diced cucumber into the yoghurt with salt to make a quick sauce.
Toast the paninis, then fill with koftas, sauce and lettuce or tomato.

meals.title: Slow-Braised Short Ribs with Carrots and Mash
meals.why: Short ribs are R109.99/kg, and braising them with budget carrots, potatoes and canned tomatoes makes a rich Sunday-style meal from a few ingredients.
method: Season the ribs and brown them well in a hot ovenproof pot, then set aside.
Fry sliced onion and garlic in the same pot, add the chopped tomatoes, a stock cube and a cup of water, and return the ribs.
Cover and cook at 160°C for 2.5 hours, adding chunky carrots for the last hour.
Boil the peeled potatoes until soft, then mash with butter and milk.
Skim the fat off the sauce and serve the ribs and carrots over the mash.

meals.title: Paprika Chicken Traybake with Potatoes and Carrots
meals.why: The 5kg braaipack works out to about R40/kg, and one tray of roasted chicken and veg feeds the family while the rest of the pack goes in the freezer.
method: Thaw the chicken pieces you need (the day before, in the fridge) and keep the rest frozen.
Toss the chicken with oil, paprika, garlic, salt, pepper and lemon juice.
Spread chunky potatoes, carrots and onion on a large tray, nestle the chicken on top, and drizzle with oil.
Roast at 200°C for 50-55 minutes, turning once, until the chicken is cooked through and the veg is golden.
Spoon the pan juices over everything and serve.

meals.title: Peri-Style Chicken Livers on Toast
meals.why: A 500g pack of chicken livers is only R21.50, which makes this one of the cheapest protein dinners of the week.
method: Thaw the livers, drain, pat dry and trim any sinew.
Fry onion and garlic in oil until soft, then add paprika and chilli.
Add the livers and sear for 3-4 minutes until browned.
Add the chopped tomatoes and simmer for 8-10 minutes until the sauce thickens and the livers are cooked through.
Finish with salt and lemon juice and serve on toasted bread.
